options.name: normalized_slot_column_plus_partial_unique_constraint
options.shape: Add a non-authoritative canonical_slot projection to player_inventory, backfill from the server definition registry, then create a unique partial index on (user_id, canonical_slot) WHERE equipped=1 AND canonical_slot IS NOT NULL.
options.rollback: Drop the unique index and projection column only after application code no longer depends on the projection; retain original equip_id/equipped authority.
options.direct_writer_coverage: All application INSERT/UPDATE writers must populate or preserve canonical_slot; admin grant must insert it; equip replacement must continue resolving slot server-side.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Grant inserts equipped=0 with the resolved projection; remove does not create a duplicate; direct admin equip is not allowed.
options.malformed_historical_data: Detect and repair/owner-review conflicts before index creation; migration must not choose latest/lowest/highest rarity automatically.
options.performance: Indexed enforcement is O(log n) for writes and makes per-user slot reads cheaper; backfill is one bounded maintenance operation.
options.postgresql_compatibility: Good; PostgreSQL partial unique indexes are native. SQLite test support needs a dialect/version check or equivalent unique-index path.
options.risk: Projection drift if definitions or direct SQL change without updating the projection; requires explicit writer inventory and repair telemetry.

options.name: derived_or_generated_slot_representation_plus_constraint
options.shape: Use a generated expression or functional index that maps equip_id to a slot and enforce uniqueness only for equipped rows.
options.backfill_required: Generated expression can avoid a data backfill but existing unknown/trophy rows still need validation before enforcement.
options.rollback: Remove generated expression/index before old app compatibility is restored.
options.direct_writer_coverage: Database expression sees equip_id but cannot consult Python EQUIPMENT_DEFS; every future catalog change requires synchronized database expression updates.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Works only while the duplicated database mapping is complete and current.
options.malformed_historical_data: Unknown IDs map to null or fail; duplicate known slots still block index creation.
options.performance: Good after index creation; expression evaluation and catalog duplication add maintenance cost.
options.postgresql_compatibility: PostgreSQL supports generated columns/expressions, but generated expressions cannot query the application registry; SQLite portability is weaker.
options.risk: Creates a second slot-definition representation and can silently drift from EQUIPMENT_DEFS.

options.name: single_command_writer_plus_reconciliation_guard
options.shape: Keep schema unchanged, centralize all equip mutations in one service, lock per user, reject malformed state, and run periodic/read-time reconciliation.
options.rollback: Revert the command-service release; no schema rollback.
options.direct_writer_coverage: Only safe if every application/admin/import writer is removed or forced through the same command boundary; current direct acquisition/admin writers remain a coverage gap.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Must use the same service or remain strictly unequipped ownership mutation.
options.malformed_historical_data: Detection and fail-closed read behavior remain; storage can remain malformed until explicit repair.
options.performance: Low migration cost; per-command user lock and reconciliation queries add runtime work.
options.postgresql_compatibility: Good, but correctness depends on application discipline rather than the database.
options.risk: Cannot guarantee the target invariant against an unreviewed direct writer or race outside the service.

slot_invariant.constraint_precondition: No unique index is created until the read-only detector reports zero unresolved duplicate effective slots, or an owner-approved repair plan has made every conflict explicit.

malformed_data_plan.source_of_slot_truth: Server EQUIPMENT_DEFS exported into a deterministic migration/audit mapping; not client fields.
malformed_data_plan.duplicate_equipped_query_shape: Join equipped player_inventory rows to an explicit equip_id-to-slot mapping, group by user_id and slot, and HAVING COUNT(*) > 1.
malformed_data_plan.unknown_equip_query_shape: LEFT JOIN equipped player_inventory to the canonical definition mapping and select rows where the mapping is null.
malformed_data_plan.xp_amulet_query_shape: Select equipped rows where equip_id='xp_amulet'; classify as HOLD_FOR_AUTHORITY review state, not automatic gameplay activation.

remediation.repair_shape: Owner-approved maintenance command selects an explicit winner or clears the slot in one audited transaction; preserve ownership rows unless separately authorized.
remediation.release_gate: Do not add the unique index or enable a strict writer until unresolved conflicts are zero or explicitly quarantined.

ordering_decisions.legacy_combat_fields_retired_before_serv: YES for writes and gameplay-adjacent effects; NO for compatibility reads until the visual bridge is complete
safe_sequence: freeze or quarantine new legacy combat_* writes and decide legacy XP/drop effect disposition
run read-only inventory and legacy-field detection
repair or owner-review malformed historical equipped rows
update every application writer to preserve canonical_slot
add the partial unique constraint after a clean precondition
retain compatibility reads only until visual consumers are bridged, then retire legacy fields
ordering_decisions.reason: A command service without a database invariant still permits an uncovered direct writer to recreate malformed state; a hard constraint cannot be added safely until historical data and all writers are understood.
